core_findings: Atlanta is a valid standalone municipal control row with a dedicated Atlanta Police Department reporting structure, not a county or airport proxy case.
The official APD 2024 Year End Crime Report provides a usable citywide annual anchor for the seven target offenses.
The same APD year-end report publishes Airport separately, and the citywide total matches the six non-airport zone totals rather than citywide plus airport.
The Atlanta municipal repair therefore should use the APD citywide table and explicitly exclude the separate airport page so the Atlanta city packet does not absorb airport ORI activity.

recommended_handling: Retain the standalone Atlanta municipal control row 13:municipal:place:1304000.
Use APD's official 2024 year-end citywide report as the local-publication repair surface for murder, rape, robbery, aggravated_assault, burglary, larceny, and motor_vehicle_theft.
Keep the separate airport reporting lane excluded from the Atlanta municipal packet.
